source: Created as design cases, not generated by LFM; no tests run
warning: These represent desired acceptance contracts. Some are deliberately RED candidates or require token-ID source validation. Do not label as observed model traces.
comparison_notes: Some expected text classification is Design-C-policy-dependent; tool execution prohibition is invariant.
Numerical lexical equivalence must be separately tested.
arbitrary byte SSE chunking is not raw tokenizer boundary.
Some negative cases have partial first commits, so ledger must be checked per envelope.
